The software product **Excel Formula GPT** at **excelformulagpt.com** is provided directly under the brand/entity **ExcelFormulaGPT** (developed/maintained on GitHub by **Celerforge**).

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Privacy Policy (`excelformulagpt.com/privacy`):** Defines the provider as: 
  > *"Company (referred to as either 'the Company', 'We', 'Us' or 'Our' in this Agreement) refers to ExcelFormulaGPT."*
  > It also states: *"Website refers to ExcelFormulaGPT, accessible from https://www.excelformulagpt.com/"*
* **Terms and Conditions (`excelformulagpt.com/terms`):** States that *"These terms and conditions outline the rules and regulations for the use of ExcelFormulaGPT's Website, located at https://www.excelformulagpt.com/"* and *"Unless otherwise stated, ExcelFormulaGPT and/or its licensors own the intellectual property rights for all material on ExcelFormulaGPT."*
* **Developer / Repository:** The website's GitHub resource links directly to developer **Celerforge** (`celerforge/excelformulagpt`).
